record.body:
## Evidence

Expected every Needs Human and Blocking Question item the handoff shows to reach the hook context or its Not shown line. Observed: fabricated effortless finding f1 and question q-1 appear in render_view(HANDOFF) but not in the hook output.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix task fix-hook-dropped-groups.

payload.basis: hook_handoff_sections keeps only groups named after a live effort; render_view(HANDOFF) shows those groups
payload.claim: behavior-bug on compact-hook-view: needs-human findings without an effort and blocking questions whose subject is not the effort slug vanish from the start hook
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and reviewer re-run passes, or a human clears it

record.subject: review-compact-hook-view-behavior-bug
